rootNote: Teaching roots set by the tutor and checked against WLC counts (OSHB 3d15126, verb tokens incl. suffixed forms): subtype II-Waw: H6965 קוּם, 627 tokens (Qal 459, Hiphil 146, Piel 11, Polel 4, Hitpolel 4, Hophal 3), the paradigm root of GKC Paradigm M, Davidson §40 and K&J. שׁוּב (1041; Qal, Hiphil, Polel, Hophal) and מוּת (832) are more frequent but attested in fewer stems, and מות is stative. Subtype II-Yod: H7760 שׂים (headword שׂוּם), 580 tokens (Qal 578, Hiphil 2), the most frequent ī-type root. Squares קום/שׂים do not attest take examples from other hollow roots of the matching type.
source: Forms from GKC §§72-73 + Paradigms M and N (PDF pp. 482-483) and Davidson, Introductory Hebrew Grammar §40 paradigm (pp. 180-181), both in /workspace/hebrew-books/ and read from page images. GKC/Davidson print the II-Yod type with בין; those squares are marked '(pattern shown with בין)'. Squares the books do not print but K&J, Learning Biblical Hebrew pt. 2, II-Waw/Yod Verb Chart (pp. 365-366) prints are formBasis 'printed'. Wayyiqtol of Niphal/Polel/Polal/Hitpolel/Hophal, Qal passive participle mp/fp and the Polel/Polal/Hitpolel fs -ֶת participles are 'rule'. Not copied from any copyrighted chart.
verificationMethod: Each form was matched (consonants + vowel points, accents ignored, dagesh lene and plene/defective ḥolem, shureq and ḥireq-yod spellings normalized) against OSHB morphhb-wlc tokens with the same OSHB morph slot; the Piel/Pual/Hitpael rows match OSHB Polel/Polal/Hitpolel (o/O/r). R1 and R3 are positional (ק, מ; in Polel/Polal/Hitpolel the repeated R3 must be the same letter); the middle ו/י and everything else must agree letter for letter. The example root was checked against its Strong's headword (R1, ו or י, R3); first radical not guttural/י/ו, third not guttural/א/ה/ו/י. Qal squares that exist in both subtypes take examples only from roots of the matching imperfect type (from WLC). Ketiv excluded. Imperatives may carry paragogic ה; infinitives construct may carry a preposition. Example preference: teaching root, then another hollow root; each in order no prefix, ו, preposition. Every matched token was cross-checked against STEPBible TAHOT; tokens where TAHOT disagrees are never used as examples.

notes.subtypes: Two subtypes share this file (field 'subtype'). 'II-Waw' (teaching root קום) fills all 207 squares; 'II-Yod' (teaching root שׂים) adds only the Qal squares where it differs (imperfect, wayyiqtol, imperative, infinitive construct, jussive). Each cell has a unique 'key' = subtype/id. In all other stems the two types are alike.
notes.iiYodBooks: GKC Paradigm N and Davidson print the II-Yod type with בין, not שׂים; K&J prints שׂים. II-Yod squares are 'book' where the בין pattern is printed (sourceRef says 'pattern shown with בין') and 'printed' where only K&J has them.
notes.stative: Stative hollow verbs: מֵת (perfect and participle with ē: מֵת, מֵתָה, מַתָּה) and בּוֹשׁ (ō: בֹּשְׁתִּי, imperfect יֵבוֹשׁ) (GKC §72 Rem. 1; Davidson p. 180 'stat.'; K&J p. 365). Note only. מות's imperfect יָמוּת is the same pattern as יָקוּם, so it may appear as an example there; its perfect never matches קָם.
notes.boa: בּוֹא is doubly weak (hollow + III-Aleph): בָּא, בָּאתָ, יָבוֹא, בּוֹא, Hiphil הֵבִיא (GKC §72, §76). Note only; never an example root.
notes.pielQiyyem: Late Piel forms with ו > י (קִיַּם Est 9:31, קִיְּמוּ Est 9:27, infinitive קַיֵּם Ez 13:6, Ru 4:7) are 'secondary formations, probably borrowed from Aramaic' (GKC §72.7). OSHB tags 11 קום tokens as Piel (stem p); they are not in this file's Polel row. Note only.
notes.pilpel: Pilpel (כִּלְכֵּל, טִלְטֵל, קַרְקַר) occurs on the analogy of geminates and is less common (GKC §72.7). Note only.
notes.fsParticiple: Hollow Qal, Niphal and Hiphil fs participles are printed only as -ָה (קָמָה, נְקוֹמָה, מְקִימָה); they are main as printed. Hophal fs is K&J's מוּקָמָה. Polel/Polal/Hitpolel fs follow the standing -ֶת ruling with K&J's -ָה as printed alternate.
notes.weqatal: וְקַמְתָּ (Davidson 'vav cons. perf.'). Note, not a column.

II-Waw.note: II-Waw (ע״וּ): Qal imperfect with ū (יָקוּם); fills all 207 squares

II-Yod.note: II-Yod (ע״י): Qal imperfect with ī (יָשִׂים); only the Qal squares that differ from the II-Waw type

stemNotes.Piel: Polel (Pôlēl) in the Piel row: hollow verbs replace Piel with Polel, ō after the first radical and the last radical repeated (GKC §72.7). OSHB stem code o.
stemNotes.Pual: Polal (Pôlal) in the Pual row: passive of Polel (GKC §72.7). OSHB stem code O.
stemNotes.Hitpael: Hitpolel (Hitpôlēl) in the Hitpael row: reflexive of Polel (GKC §72.7). OSHB stem code r.
